import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats

# Convert the 'Sex of respondent, 1979' column to a categorical variable
df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] = df['Sex of respondent, 1979'].astype('category')

# Convert the 'Highest grade completed, 1979' column to a numerical variable
df['Highest grade completed, 1979'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Highest grade completed, 1979'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with missing values
df = df.dropna(subset=['Sex of respondent, 1979', 'Highest grade completed, 1979'])

# Group the data by sex and calculate the mean highest grade completed
grouped_data = df.groupby('Sex of respondent, 1979')['Highest grade completed, 1979'].mean()
print(grouped_data)

# Perform a t-test to determine if there is a significant difference in mean highest grade completed between males and females
t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 1]['Highest grade completed, 1979'],
                                   df[df['Sex of respondent, 1979'] == 2]['Highest grade completed, 1979'])
print(f't-statistic: {t_stat}, p-value: {p_value}')
